items.t: TeraWulf Stock Fell 24% in a Month. Lucid Capital Still Sees 67% Upside
items.sum: Key TakeawaysTeraWulf (WULF) fell approximately 24% between October 6 and November 6, 2026, closing at $11. 37 as financing concerns pressured AI infrastructure stocks.

items.t: Applied Digital Sinks 8% as Nebius Outlook and NVIDIA CEO Exit Hit AI Data Center Stocks; Cipher Digital Falls 4%, TeraWulf Slides 3%
items.sum: A weak spending outlook from one AI cloud player and a surprise leadership change at the chip giant have rattled data center landlords. One name carrying heavy debt is feeling the pain most, and its next financing test may decide what comes next.

items.t: TeraWulf COO: 83% of Revenue Now Comes From AI as Lake Mariner Nears Completion
items.sum: TeraWulf was one of the earliest Bitcoin miners to pivot to AI infrastructure, and its Q3 results show 83% of revenue now coming from those AI services.

items.t: TeraWulf Stock Rises With AI Infrastructure Stocks After CoreWeave Earnings
items.sum: TeraWulf Inc. (NASDAQ: WULF), now an AI infrastructure company, is rising Wednesday as CoreWeave's earnings lift AI infrastructure stocks.
